name: Comfort UI
author: Local UI Workshop
description:
Comfort UI 0.6.0 stable release: a configurable 13-language interface and in-game keyboard with local word suggestions, Chinese pinyin, Japanese romaji/common kanji, Korean Hangul composition, language switching and enabled/default keyboard settings. Desktop Windows IME/Win+H uses an embedded child of the game window, with no external input dialog. System IMEs/speech require appropriate Windows components; actual Cohtml/Win+H/VR compatibility still needs client testing.

Includes cumulative menu, scrolling/font, camera, microphone state/feedback, chat bubble, nameplate, animation and translation bridge fixes. Typed JSON events, explicit escaping, strict response/session checks and plain-text rendering are retained. Stable is the release channel, not a guarantee of bug-free operation.

[Installer](https://github.com/xuan5636/ChilloutVR-ComfortUI/releases/download/v0.6.0/ComfortUI-Setup-0.6.0.exe) | [Keyboard guide](https://github.com/xuan5636/ChilloutVR-ComfortUI/blob/v0.6.0/docs/KEYBOARD.md) | [Release/feedback](https://github.com/xuan5636/ChilloutVR-ComfortUI/releases/tag/v0.6.0)

Online translation remains opt-in and sends selected/visible text to the chosen service. Suggestions stay local. Word data has separate CC BY-SA/MIT/Apache notices. Unofficial mod, not affiliated with, approved, verified or supported by ChilloutVR or Alpha Blend Interactive. Modifications may affect performance, security or stability.
requirements: Windows x64 and .NET Framework 4.8; local model download is optional. See repository installation and translation documentation.
changelog: 0.6.0 stable: in-game multilingual keyboard, local suggestions, Chinese/Japanese/Korean composition, bottom language switching, configurable enabled/default keyboards and an embedded desktop Windows IME/voice input target. Retains cumulative menu, camera, chat, microphone and typed-event security repairs. Client IME/Win+H/VR validation remains outstanding; see keyboard and validation docs.
